let active = 0;
let peak = 0;
const done = [];
async function handle(evt) {
  active += 1;
  peak = Math.max(peak, active);
  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20));
  active -= 1;
  done.push(evt.id);
}

// CASE braceless_switch_forof expect=fire
async function dispatchAll(events) {
  for (const evt of events)
    switch (evt.type) {
      case "save":
        await handle(evt);
        break;
      default:
        await handle(evt);
    }
}

// CASE braceless_switch_classic expect=fire
async function dispatchIndexed(events) {
  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++)
    switch (events[i].type) {
      case "save":
        await handle(events[i]);
        break;
      default:
        await handle(events[i]);
    }
}

// CASE harness expect=pass
const events = [1, 2, 3, 4].map((id) => ({
  id,
  type: id % 2 ? "save" : "other",
}));
dispatchAll(events)
  .then(() => dispatchIndexed(events))
  .then(() => {
    console.log(JSON.stringify({ peak, serial: peak === 1, done }));
    if (peak !== 1 || done.length !== 8) process.exit(1);
  });
